issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'מִיָּבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד' means 'from Jabesh-gilead' (a place name). The Chinese renders it as '約別士人基列' which appears to be a garbled transliteration, splitting 'Jabesh' into '約別士' and adding '人' (people) incorrectly, and rendering 'Gilead' as '基列'. This misrepresents the proper name 'Jabesh-gilead' and could confuse the reader about the place name.
